task_completion.description: The Subsurface application is open and the window is maximized.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Subsurface application window fills the screen, showing the dive list and profile view.

task_completion.description: The agent accessed the column configuration menu (usually via right-click on the header or preferences).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A context menu or a 'Configure Columns' dialog box is visible over the dive list.

task_completion.description: The 'SAC' (Surface Air Consumption) column is enabled and visible in the dive list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A column header labeled 'SAC' is present in the main dive list table.

task_completion.description: The 'CNS' (Central Nervous System oxygen toxicity) column is enabled and visible in the dive list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A column header labeled 'CNS' is present in the main dive list table.

task_completion.description: The 'Rating' column has been removed or hidden from the dive list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The column header labeled 'Rating' (usually stars) is no longer visible in the dive list headers.

integrity.description: The agent used the graphical user interface to change settings rather than editing configuration files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the dive list header or the preferences menu.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Subsurface software interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UI elements (buttons, list items, menus) respond to clicks and hover states in the trajectory.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the command line to force-close or bypass the UI configuration steps.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal is not used to execute 'sed' or 'echo' commands into Subsurface config files.

privileged_info_for_vlm: In Subsurface, columns are typically toggled by right-clicking the header of the dive list. The 'SAC' column displays gas consumption rates, and 'CNS' displays oxygen toxicity percentages. The 'Rating' column usually displays star icons. The final state must show the dive list with SAC and CNS headers present and the Rating header absent.
